economy.summary: Runs a 'Raise the Wage' petition drive on his official House page asking whether Pennsylvania's minimum wage should be more than the current $7.25 per hour, seeking one million signatures to deliver to the governor and Senate majority leader in support of raising it.
economy.short: Supports raising Pennsylvania's $7.25 minimum wage; runs petition drive.

taxes.summary: Voted for the 2026-27 state budget, saying it spends responsibly without adding new taxes or tapping state reserve funds, and continues the Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit; he called it a commonsense plan that prioritizes real-life needs.
taxes.short: Voted for budget he says adds no new taxes, spends responsibly.

abortion.summary: Has a mixed voting record on abortion: he voted for several restrictions including a 2019 ban on abortions sought due to a Down syndrome diagnosis and 2011-2013 bills barring abortion coverage in the state's ACA exchange, but voted against the 2022 constitutional amendment stating there is no right to abortion and against a 2017 ban on abortions after 20 weeks.
abortion.short: Voted for some abortion restrictions, against no-right amendment and 20-week ban.

education.summary: Voted for the 2026-27 state budget and said education was a top priority in it, with across-the-board funding increases distributed to local school districts throughout the region.
education.short: Voted for budget with increased funding for school districts.

healthcare.summary: Voted for the 2026-27 state budget, citing its increased funding for Medical Assistance, mental health services, and prescription drug assistance, along with cost-of-living increases for retired public servants.
healthcare.short: Voted for budget increasing Medical Assistance, mental health, drug assistance.

energy.summary: Co-chairs the Pennsylvania Nuclear Energy Caucus and supported 2026 legislation adjusting state fees to clear the way for small modular nuclear reactors, saying nuclear power is an important part of a diversified energy strategy that would bring new jobs and meet growing electricity demand.
energy.short: Supports nuclear power expansion; backed small modular reactor legislation.
